bypassBlockingThresholdTooltip.message: When enabled, any domain flagged by this provider will be immediately blocked, bypassing the two-provider threshold. This may increase false positives.

blockNewlyRegisteredTooltip.message: When enabled, this provider blocks domains that were registered within the past 90 days. This may increase false positives.

blockSuspiciousTooltip.message: When enabled, this provider blocks domains it has flagged as suspicious, even if they haven't been confirmed as hosting malicious content. This may increase false positives.

blockDynamicDnsTooltip.message: When enabled, this provider blocks domains that use dynamic DNS services, which are sometimes abused by threat actors. This may increase false positives.

welcomeIntro.message: Osprey's protection is activated. You don't need to do anything else.

welcomeWhyBody.message: Some websites are fake. They pretend to be your bank, a delivery company, or an online platform like Instagram so they can steal your passwords, your banking details, or your personal information. These fake websites can look extremely real. Osprey blocks up to 99% of them before they open to keep your browsing safe.

welcomeHowStep1.message: Use the internet exactly like you always do.

welcomeHowStep2.message: If you try to open a dangerous website, Osprey blocks it and shows a warning page instead.

welcomeHowStep3.message: Press the 'Back to safety' button to close the dangerous website.

welcomeSafeBody.message: Osprey only steps in when a website is known to be dangerous. Everything else works as normal.

welcomeIconBody.message: Osprey works quietly in the background. The icon is in the top corner of your browser (click the puzzle piece icon if you don't see it). You can click it to see that you are protected.
